Act 1 · The 2 Sigma Problem

The best way to learn has been known for 40 years.
Almost no one could afford it.

In 1984, educational psychologist Benjamin Bloom found that students taught one-to-one with mastery learning performed two standard deviations better than students in a conventional classroom. The average tutored learner outscored 98% of the classroom — the same person, a profoundly different outcome.

He called it the 2 Sigma Problem: we know what works, but a personal tutor for every learner has never been affordable at scale. That gap — between how people can learn and how they're made to learn — is the problem Zavmo exists to close.

Bloom (1984), “The 2 Sigma Problem.” The tutored distribution sits two standard deviations to the right — the average tutored student beats ~98% of conventionally-taught peers.

Act 2 · Making learning as unique as you are

One product. Three learners.
Three completely different experiences.

A personal tutor doesn't teach everyone the same lesson — they start from who you are and where you're going. So does Zavmo. We created three real accounts on learn.zavmo.ai, each choosing a different path. Everything below is captured live — same platform, addressing each person by name, shaped around what they told us.

The invisible 13th member

Agent 13 — your flow-state orchestrator

The best tutors read the room. Agent 13 does it in real time: a silent thirteenth member of the team that reads your flow state — challenge versus skill, engagement, cognitive load — moment to moment, and hands you to the right teacher at the right time. Drifting into boredom or overload? It switches the approach before you even notice. Grounded in Csíkszentmihályi's flow theory, it never speaks to you directly — it just keeps you in the zone where real learning happens.

Then she proves it — and earns the credit.

Demonstrate is where learning becomes evidence. As Donna completes each lesson, its module turns ready to assess — and Zavmo reviews what she shows against every assessment criterion, building toward a real, recognised certificate, not a participation badge.

● Demonstrate — Donna's completed modules now “ready” to prove, each assessed against its criteria

And it paces the whole journey around your life.

A tutor doesn't just teach — they pace you. Zavmo takes Donna's hours and her chosen path and lays a dated, adaptive schedule: a realistic finish date, sessions per week, and what's next. Life gets in the way? She just talks to Zavmo and the plan re-flows around her.

● Donna's adaptive schedule — projected finish, sessions per week, and the week ahead, all captured live
Act 3 · The proof loop

Personal isn't a setting. It's a loop.

A great tutor pays attention — and adjusts. Zavmo does the same by capturing 42 kinds of learning event live today, as open xAPI statements. Every signal feeds a Learner Signal Bundle that shapes the next interaction. That's how one-to-one teaching scales: the platform actually knows you, and keeps learning you.

01
You declare
Confidence, goals, obstacles, how you like to learn — captured as signals during onboarding & beyond.
02
Zavmo captures
Every lesson, answer, setback and celebration becomes an xAPI statement — a true record of how you learn.
03
It personalises
The Signal Bundle is injected into every tutor prompt — scaffolding, pace, examples and tone adapt to you.
04
You grow
Progress generates new signals — confidence rises, the picture sharpens, and the loop tightens around you.
